verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a team remote-access admin product, but no evidence documents a bulk action across many computers, users, or sessions at once. The Teams API for automating deployment and reporting is a developer building block, not a bulk-operations feature. Assigning a Team Computer to a group and SCIM/SSO provisioning are adjacent features, not bulk actions on many items. Missing for 10: any documented bulk/multi-select or batch operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
